behavioral_effects: New-file gate extracted to .claude/hooks/new_file_gate.py with matcher Write|NotebookEdit and sanctioned-dir auto-allow, so the ask signal now means something
Allowlist gains cd backend uv run fullstack, make taskiq-*, make db-*, cd frontend bun run
compatibility_impact: Gate behaviour is a strict superset of the old inline gate: everything it allowed is still allowed, so no new prompts for existing flows
limitations: MCP filesystem writers still bypass the gate; the deny-rule decision is parked for S13 deliberation
The inline one-liner was deleted (net negative in settings.json), the script is net-new code with docstring-stated invariants
reason: The inline Write-only gate misses NotebookEdit and prompts even in directories where new files are the norm, and missing allowlist entries turn every rag CLI or taskiq invocation into a permission prompt
rollback: git revert restores the inline python -c gate and the narrower allowlist
security_impact: The gate now covers NotebookEdit, closing a silent write bypass; permissions additions are dev-loop commands (rag CLI, taskiq, db, bun run) with no secret or destructive surface. MCP filesystem-writer denies deliberately deferred to S13 per user decision
summary: Extract the new-file gate to a script covering NotebookEdit and sanctioned dirs; widen the permissions allowlist

validators_run.evidence_ref: 8 synthetic events - sanctioned-dir allow, service-file ask, NotebookEdit ask (previously silently bypassed), scratchpad allow, new-skill allow, frontend test-suffix allow, outside-repo ask, malformed-input fail-open
